config.system_prompt_details: DevFoundry software development assistant. The message is judged WITHOUT the conversation, so it is often a reply inside an ongoing workflow. ON-TOPIC (never flag): greetings, thanks and pleasantries; short replies and choices such as yes, no, ok, go ahead, 1, Option 2, answers to numbered questions; describing any software product or idea; asking to see, show, find, explain or compare the PRD, TRD, project proposal, repository or folder structure (e.g. 'where is the PRD?', 'show me the TRD'); asking what changed, why a technology was chosen, or the status of the project; approving, rejecting or complaining about a reply (including frustrated or informal wording); changing features, requirements, technologies, names, files or commits; Azure DevOps project, repository, push and commit steps; general software engineering questions. OFF-TOPIC: requests with no relation to building software, e.g. poems, recipes, weather, sports, news, trivia, personal advice.
